widgets.widgetName: Line A. Check the appropriate box for your entity type
Line B. Enter the name of the Targeted Tax Area (T T A) business
Line C. Enter the address (actual location) where the T T A business is conducted
Line D. Enter the name of the specific area of the T T A in which the business and/or investment activity is located
Line E. Enter the six-digit Principal Business Activity code of the T T A Business
Line F. Total number of employees in the T T A
Line G. Gross annual receipts of the business
Line H. Total asset value of the business
S S N or I T I N, C A Corporation number, F E I N (12 digits)
Select Entity type
widgets.text: Social Security Number (S S N) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers (I T I N).

widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on your California tax return
Qualified taxpayer's S I C code. See instructions
California Secretary of State (S O S) file number (12 digits)
Part I, Line 1a. Hiring credit carryover from Schedule Z, line 8A, column (f) or line 10, column (c)
Line 1b. Sales or use tax credit carryover from Schedule Z, line 9A, column (f) or line 11, column (c)
Line 1c. Add line 1a and line 1b
Line 1d. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions

Part II, Line 2. Enter the average apportionment percentage of your business that is in the former T T A from Worksheet I, Section A, line 4. If your operation is wholly within the former T T A, the average apportionment percentage is 100% (1.00)
Part III, Line 3a. Enter the total N O L carryover from prior years from Worksheet II, line 9, column (b)

Line 3b. Enter the total N O L deduction used in the current year from Worksheet II, line 9, column (c). Enter this amount on Schedule C A (540), Part I, Section B, line 9b3, column B; Schedule C A (540NR), Part II, Section B, line 9b3, column B; Form 100, line 20; Form 100W, line 20; Form 100S, line 18; or Form 109, line 6
Line 3c. Enter the T T A N O L carryover to future years from Worksheet II, line 9, column (e)

Part I, Line 1. Trade or business income. Individuals: Enter the amount from Worksheet I, Section B, line 14, column (c) on this line and on line 3 (skip line 2). See instructions. Corporations which file a combined report, enter the taxpayer's business income apportioned to California (see instructions for form FTB 3809, Part II)
Part III, Line 10. Hiring credit carryover, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 10. Hiring credit carryover, (c) Credit carryover used this year by S corporation
Line 10. Hiring credit carryover, (d) Carryover column (b) minus column (c)
Line 11. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 11. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (c) Credit carryover used this year by S corporation
Line 11. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (d) Carryover column (b) minus column (c)
Part IV, Line 12. Hiring credit carryover, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 12. Hiring credit carryover, (c) Total credit assigned from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g)
Line 12. Hiring credit carryover, (d) Total credit carryover column (b) minus column (c)
Line 13. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 13. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (c) Total credit assigned from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g)
Line 13. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (d) Total credit carryover column (b) minus column (c)
Line 2. Corporations: Enter the average apportionment percentage from Worksheet I, Section A, line 4. See instructions
Line 3. Multiply line 1 by line 2
Line 4. Enter the T T A N O L deduction from Worksheet II, line 9, column (c)
Line 5. T T A taxable income. Subtract line 4 from line 3
Line 6a. Compute the amount of tax due using the amount on line 5. See instructions

Line 6b. Enter the amount of tax from Form 540, line 35; Form 540NR, line 42; Form 541, line 21; Form 100, line 23; Form 100W, line 23; Form 100S, line 21; or Form 109, line 10. Corporations and S corporations, see instructions
Line 7. Enter the smaller of line 6a or line 6b. This is the limitation based on the T T A business income. Go to Part II, Part III, or Part IV. See instructions
Part II, Line 8A. Hiring credit carryover, (e) Limitation based on T T A business income
Line 8A. Hiring credit carryover, (f) Credit carryover used on Schedule P can never be greater than column (d) or column (e)
Line 8B. Hiring credit carryover, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 8B. Hiring credit carryover, (c) Total credit assigned from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g)
Line 8B. Hiring credit carryover, (d) Total credit column (b) minus column (c)
Line 8B. Hiring credit carryover, (e) Limitation based on T T A business income
Line 8B. Hiring credit carryover, (g) Total credit carryover column (d) minus column (e)
Line 9A. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (e) Limitation based on T T A business income
Line 9A. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (f) Credit carryover used on Schedule P can never be greater than column (d) or column (e)
Line 9B. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 9B. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (c) Total credit assigned from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g)
Line 9B. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (d) Total credit column (b) minus column (c)
Line 9B. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (e) Limitation based on T T A business income
Line 9B. Sales or use tax credit carryover, (g) Total credit carryover column (d) minus column (e)
